sources.entry: Work Hours - Simple app that tracks your work hours from the menu bar. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/niteoweb/work-hours-mac)

summary.one_liner: A small macOS menu bar app that tracks work hours, storing the records in a CSV file.
summary.what_it_does: The app runs in the Mac status bar and times your work sessions. It stores its data as a CSV file in the Documents folder and produces daily and monthly reports. When the Mac goes to sleep, the timer stops automatically. The README says the app uses event sourcing backed by the CSV file. The README does not describe the user interface or report format in more detail.
use_cases: track work hours on a Mac
log time worked from the menu bar
generate daily or monthly work hour reports
keep a private CSV record of working time
automatic time tracking that pauses at sleep
how_to_run: Download the app from the link in the README (macOS 11.0 or later)
notable: Lives in the macOS status bar
Data is stored as a plain CSV file in Documents
Uses event sourcing via the CSV file
Stops the timer automatically when the Mac sleeps
caveats: The README does not state a license
README is brief and gives little detail on installation or the build process
